polity.canonical_name_en: Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes

activity.notes: Peter I was the last King of Serbia and became the first king of the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes when the new South Slav kingdom was proclaimed on 1 December 1918. He remained king until his death on 16 August 1921. The state was not officially named the Kingdom of Yugoslavia during Peter I's reign; that renaming occurred in 1929 under Alexander I. ATLAS therefore maps the user's Yugoslavia label to the historically correct 1918-1921 polity and does not merge Peter's earlier 1903-1918 Serbian reign into this Activity.

sources.title: The Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes — The Royal Family of Serbia
sources.citation_text: The Royal Family of Serbia records the proclamation of the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes on 1 December 1918 under King Peter I.
